title: A covering sieve on a quasi-compact etale object contains a finite affine cover
statement: For any universe u, let X : Scheme.{u}, W : X.Etale with [CompactSpace W.left], and R : Sieve W a covering sieve, R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. There exist n : ℕ, U : Fin n → X.Etale, and g : ∀ a, U a ⟶ W such that (∀ a, R (g a)), (∀ a, IsAffine (U a).left), and ⋃ a, Set.range (g a).left = Set.univ. Thus every chosen arrow belongs to R, every source is affine, and the arrows are jointly surjective on W. The base X need not be quasi-compact or quasi-separated, and no quasi-separatedness of W is assumed. The finite index n may be zero, including when W is empty.

source.place: Line 71, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology; universe u and implicit base X at lines 60-66.

proof.text: Unpack covering-sieve membership into an etale scheme cover whose arrows generate a subsieve of R. Each etale covering arrow is an open map, so this cover is a QuasiCompactCover.

Apply QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact to the compact open Set.univ of W. Compactness of W.left gives finitely many affine opens V a in selected members of the cover, with their images covering W.

Let U a be the etale X-object obtained by restricting that selected cover member to V a. Define g a by composing the open inclusion with the cover arrow. The sieve is downward closed, so R (g a). The affine-open property makes (U a).left affine, and the equality of the union of the images of V a with Set.univ gives ⋃ a, Set.range (g a).left = Set.univ. The construction allows n=0.

lemma exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology {W : X.Etale} [CompactSpace W.left]
    {R : Sieve W} (hR : R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Etale) (g : ∀ a, U a ⟶ W), (∀ a, R (g a)) ∧
      (∀ a, IsAffine (U a).left) ∧ ⋃ a, Set.range (g a).left = Set.univ
